tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: ProBlogger Job Board RSS of active postings (WPJobBoard, RSS 2.0): GET /jobs/wpjobboard/xml/rss/?filter=active, with `query` carried into the board's search (?query=writer narrows it). The WordPress /jobs/feed/ used before carried no <item> elements on 2026-09-25 and 2026-09-26 while this feed listed the board's live postings (live check 2026-09-26). The feed is one list, so page and limit are not sent (next_page is always null); category, min_budget are not sent. Items use the standard RSS fields (title, link, pubDate, description); id is the posting link.
